LU-8				LUBRICATION SYSTEM — Oil Pump

8. REMOVE BRAKE HOSE BRACKETS AND CLIPS

9. DISCONNECT INTERMEDIATE SHAFT
Loosen the bolt, disconnect the intermediate shaft.

10. DISCONNECT STABILIZER BAR LINKS FROM LOWER ARMS
11. REMOVE ENGINE MOUNTING NUTS AND WASHERS
Attach the engine hoist chain to the two engine hangers.
12. REMOVE TEMS ACTUATOR

13. REMOVE SHOCK ABSORBERS FROM BODY

14. DISCONNECT FRONT SUSPENSION MEMBER
(a) Hold the front suspension member with a jack.
(b) Remove the two bolts and four nuts.
